# mtncloud_domain (Data Source)

Provides an MTN Cloud domain data source: looks up a network domain by name or ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_environment" "testdomain" {
  name = "test.local"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the MTN Cloud domain

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the domain is active
- `description` (String) The description of the MTN Cloud domain
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
- `visibility` (String) The visibility of the MTN Cloud domain
